tool_input.command:
t=$(mktemp -d) && mkdir -p "$t/dest" && touch "$t/dest/a.txt.sha256"
bash rotate.sh --dest "$t/dest" --name demo --keep=0 2>&1 | tail -1; echo "rc=$?"
bash rotate.sh --dest "$t/dest" --name demo --bogus >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "unknown rc=$?"
bash verify.sh 2>&1 >/dev/null | tail -1; echo "missing-dest rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
bash rotate.sh --dest="$t/dest" --name=demo --keep 1 --dry-run; echo "eq-form rc=$?"
rm -rf "$t"

t=$(mktemp -d) && mkdir -p "$t/dest"
bash rotate.sh --dest "$t/dest" --name demo --keep=0 2>&1 | tail -1
bash rotate.sh --dest "$t/dest" --name demo --bogus >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "unknown rc=$?"
bash verify.sh >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "missing-dest rc=$?"
bash rotate.sh --dest="$t/dest" --name=demo --keep 1 --dry-run; echo "eq-form rc=$?"
bash rotate.sh --dest "$t/dest" --name demo -h | head -2; echo "help rc=$?"
rm -rf "$t"

mkdir -p /tmp/rotcheck/dest
bash rotate.sh --dest /tmp/rotcheck/dest --name demo --keep=0 2>&1 | tail -1
bash rotate.sh --dest /tmp/rotcheck/dest --name demo --bogus >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "unknown rc=$?"
bash verify.sh >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "missing-dest rc=$?"
bash rotate.sh --dest=/tmp/rotcheck/dest --name=demo --keep 1 --dry-run; echo "eq-form rc=$?"
bash rotate.sh --dest /tmp/rotcheck/dest --name demo -h | head -2; echo "help rc=$?"
rm -rf /tmp/rotcheck

result:
All 10 tests pass, including the 4 new ones. Summary of the changes:

- **`rotate.sh`** — the rotation cut was inverted: `tail -n +"$keep"` selected the entries to delete, so with exactly N archives and `--keep N` it deleted the *newest*. Now `surplus()` emits the oldest `total - keep` entries (`head -n`), the early exit fires at `total <= keep`, and the newest N are kept. Also now sources the new lib.
- **`verify.sh`** — the sidecar line was split with `awk '{print $2}'`, truncating names at the first space, so `my backup-….tar.gz` looked "missing" → BAD. Now `read -r expected file` takes the whole remainder of the line as the file name; the digest comparison is quoted. Also sources the new lib.
- **`lib/common.sh`** (new) — the shared option-parsing block (`--dest/--name/--keep/-q/-n/-h/--`/`parse_local_option` hook, `is_uint`, `need_value`) and `resolve_dir`, moved out of `rotate.sh` and `verify.sh`; both keep accepting the same flags (verified: `--keep=0` rejection, unknown option rc=1, missing `--dest` rc=1, `--dest=`/`--name=` forms, `-h`). `backup.sh`, `restore.sh`, `report.sh` left untouched.
- **`tests/run_tests.sh`** — new tests: rotate with exactly KEEP archives deletes nothing and the newest survives; `--keep 2` of 3 deletes the oldest; verify passes an intact archive named `my backup-20260101-000000.tar.gz` with rc=0.

One note: my scratch file `tests/check_flags.sh` (the flag spot-check) couldn't be deleted because `rm` needs approval in this sandbox — please delete it, or approve a delete and I'll rerun.

Changed files: `rotate.sh`, `verify.sh`, `lib/common.sh` (new), `tests/run_tests.sh`.
